definitions.gloss: hangover; the morning-after effects of drinking alcohol
definitions.explanation: the physical and mental symptoms experienced after excessive alcohol consumption, typically including headache, nausea, and fatigue

examples.japanese: {二日酔|ふつかよ}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: I have a headache from the hangover.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨夜|さくや}→昨夜：02999_sakuya⟧⟦{飲|の}みすぎ→飲みすぎ：22059_nomisugi⟧て、{二日酔|ふつかよ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: I drank too much last night and have a terrible hangover.

examples.japanese: {二日酔|ふつかよ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ。
examples.english: The best thing for a hangover is to drink lots of water and rest.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧ (two days, second day) + {酔|よ}い (drunkenness) → lingering drunkenness on the second day

The name refers to the fact that symptoms persist into the next day after drinking.

COMMON SYMPTOMS:
- ⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧ (headache)
- ⟦{吐|は}き{気|け}→吐き気：05021_hakike⟧ (nausea)
- {胃|い}もたれ (upset stomach)
- だるさ (fatigue)

REMEDIES ({対処法|たいしょほう}):
- ⟦{水分補給|すいぶんほきゅう}→水分補給：14832_suibunhokyuu⟧ (hydration)
- ウコン (turmeric) - popular hangover remedy in Japan
- しじみ{汁|じる} (freshwater clam soup)
- {二日酔|ふつかよ}い{薬|ぐすり} (hangover medicine)
